label: type3_causal_conflict
rationale: Hypothesis B asserts position embeddings are the causal mechanism producing dominant/outlier dimensions. Hypothesis A reports that mBERT, built with that same position-embedding-based procedure, is anisotropic yet shows no dominant dimension -- the claimed cause is present but the predicted effect is absent, undermining the asserted causal link rather than merely reflecting a difference in measurement scale (type2) or a dataset/hyperparameter difference the hypotheses themselves already rule out by stating the procedure is the same (not type4).
